name: tensorust-ontology
description: Who really owns and controls US organizations and property, from public records: county property rolls, state business registries, SEC subsidiary lists, FCC licensing and ownership, USAC E-Rate, federal awards and the FAA aircraft registry. Also BDC private credit loan marks from SEC 10-Q filings, federal research awards exposed to banned-vendor lists (DoD 1260H, Section 889, FCC Covered List, UFLPA, BIOSECURE), set-aside contractor performance, ROAD Act investor screening, No Surprises Act IDR outcomes and a catalog of 145 entity-level datasets with free samples. Hosted streamable-HTTP server: free answers need no key; full results take a Tensorust key as an Authorization Bearer header.

TENSORUST_API_KEY.description: Tensorust API key (starts with tdk_), sent as an Authorization Bearer header to unlock full=true results. Only used by the http-api-key method; the default http method needs no key.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. No account or key: every tool returns a free preview.

http-api-key.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server with a Tensorust key, so tools called with full=true return every linked object and row.
